meta.title: SenseNova Suite
meta.description: Multi-account key pool with 429 rate-limit scheduling (RPM/TPM classification, key state machine with kick-out and time-gate recovery, per-credit-group isolation and quota ledger, multi-round rotation/retry with a unified backoff ladder), tri-protocol adapter (anthropic/responses/chat-completions) with per-model protocol downgrade chains, credits and usage monitoring, and multimodal tools (image generation/editing and vision relay).
